name: Johnson SteelWorks
old_description: Your resource for creative metalwork and custom repairs in Jackson, Wyoming.
about:
Johnson SteelWorks operates from Jackson, Wyoming, offering creative metalwork and custom repair services across the Jackson Hole region. The business presents itself as a sole proprietorship, with the owner handling inquiries, scheduling, and fabrication directly. No founding year is published, and ownership details such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status are not disclosed.

The shop provides structural fabrication, mobile welding, artistic metalwork, trailer and RV repair, architectural fabrication, equipment repair, custom railings, one-of-a-kind fireplaces, and metal signage. Work is performed both at the shop and in the field, with mobile service covering Jackson, Moran, and Bondurant. No facility size, headcount, annual volume, or part-number count is provided.

Customers include homeowners, contractors, agricultural operators, and trailer owners needing custom railings, window shrouds, loader buckets, mower decks, fireplace doors, screens, spark arrestors, and decorative metal pieces. The service area centers on Teton County, with explicit mention of Jackson, Moran, and Bondurant.

The founder states that creating interesting and artistic things out of metal, both functional and ornamental, is what drew them into the trade. The business emphasizes taking projects from photos or drawings through to finished installation.
